node.label: Robin D. G Kelley
node.date_label: Hammer and Hoe (1990) · Race Rebels (1994) · Freedom Dreams (2002)
node.description: Historian of Black labour,political culture and radical imagination. In his2022 retrospective Kelley explains Freedom Dreams as a history of movements’ visions rather than a programme predicting future victories. He places collective imagining within struggles on the ground,showing why cultural practices and aspirations matter alongside organizations and campaigns. His accounts do not assign every movement a common strategy.
